name: The City Folk
source:
You are a normal single person of everyday life in the city, you don't live in the best part of it but that's okay because there's always something interesting going on. You finally get a long weekend and decide that going out would be a nice change maybe, just maybe, you'll meet someone; just keep an eye over your shoulder, and don't put down your drink.

The City Folk is meant to be a thriller like dating sim, the city can be a nice place but there always a darker spot in a place you call home. Playing on the fact that horrible things like drugs, prostitution, kidnapping and much more happen a lot around the club scene. As well as how the characters in this ended up here by a matter of bad timing and chance.

[From the [url=https://m07h-m4n.gfx.work/the-city-folk]official website[/url]]
translation:
你是城市日常生活中的一个普通单身人士，你不住在最好的地方，但这没关系，因为总会有一些有趣的事情发生。你终于度过了一个长周末，并决定出去玩是一个不错的改变，也许，只是也许，你会遇到某个人；只要留意你的肩膀，不要放下你的饮料。

《城市民谣》是一款像约会模拟游戏一样的惊悚片，城市可能是一个不错的地方，但在你称之为家的地方总是有一个黑暗的地方。利用这样一个事实：毒品、卖淫、绑架等可怕的事情在俱乐部里经常发生。以及其中的人物是如何由于糟糕的时机和机会而最终来到这里的。

[摘自[url=https://m07h-m4n.gfx.work/the-city-folk]官网[/url]]
